Help me set up the pay transparency report for our client Bakkerij Peeters, a bakery with 48 employees: bakers, shop staff, delivery drivers and two office staff. Which job classification should we group them by?

Use the sector classification their pay scales already follow, not our generic job families, because the works council negotiates on those levels and will recognise them. And put the two office staff with the shop staff, so no group is small enough to show one person's salary.
